page.layout: Single printed page of text, no margin notes. Top: page number "3" above a decorative woodcut border. Then a centred dedication heading in capitals, a centred italic motto line, and the body text with a large historiated initial "U" at the start of the first paragraph. Bottom: signature "A 2" at left and catchword "nuper" at right.

main_text.head: BONÆ SPEI ET PRÆCLARÆ indolis adolescentulo JOHANNI VULTEJO Marpurgensi, HERMANNI illius VULTEJI Jureconsulti celeberrimi, filio:
main_text.p: 'Gratiam & Salutem ab eo, à quo Vno ad Vnum omnia.

Undecennales meæ disputationes publicæ & privatæ, cum lectione philosophorum assidua conjunctæ, genuerunt in animo meo Ideam solvendi vitiosas ratiocinatiunculas. Hunc fœ-tum nunc exclusum, ἀσπάζομαι [?] sim, si citò perire cupiam. Itaque cum obstetrice alimenta & amictum à me jam habet sibi procurata, & in posterum, si vita suppeditaverit, habitu-rus est: ut de nutricatione & cultu corporis cura mihi reliquum vix sit quicquam. Officium tractationis & gestationis, ne perpetuò in cunis ille jaceat, & elanguescat, adhuc de-sidero ac vehementer requiro. Hic, ingenue adolescens, genius meus te mihi ostendit unu, [?] nuper

page.notes: The top of the page carries the printed number "3" above the woodcut border. The motto line "Gratiam & Salutem ab eo, à quo Vno ad Vnum omnia." is set in a smaller italic centred style and is transcribed as a paragraph, not a heading. The Greek word after "exclusum," is only partly legible and is marked [?]. The word "unu," at the end of the last full line may be printed as "unû," and is marked [?]. The catchword "nuper" sits on the signature line at the right, so it is not repeated in the text. The page is a dedication opening and has no running head.
